## Checklist

- [ ] SVGs are in `svg/<family>/<kebab-name>.svg`, on a square `viewBox`
- [ ] Own fills, dark outline, no `currentColor`, no external references
- [ ] Checked at 24 px and 48 px, on light and dark backgrounds (the catalog has both)
- [ ] `npm run build` ran and the regenerated files are committed
- [ ] No existing icon was renamed or removed (that needs a major version)
